verdict: Leads surged 67% this week — but none are converting to pipeline yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns delivered 93 leads at a cost of $22.97 per lead — and this past week saw a 67% jump in leads on virtually flat spend, confirming the efficiency gain is real. The top-performing campaign drove that result by finding its audience and converting at scale. However, 74 contacts entered your system this period with zero appointments or active cases created, which means leads are arriving but not being followed through to intake — that is a pipeline process issue, not an advertising issue. We are working with you to identify and close that intake gap so the leads being generated can actually move forward. If that is addressed, the volume this campaign is now capable of delivering becomes significantly more valuable.
